Scenario fixture: aria-role-name-present

Covers the roles WAI-ARIA marks "Accessible Name Required: True" and names from the author only: grid, meter, progressbar, radiogroup, tree. Allowed name sources: aria-label, aria-labelledby, title — subtree content is NOT a valid name source for these roles. Section G covers the roles that merely allow an author name and are out of scope. Each target has a stable id role_case_NN.

A. One pass/fail pair per name-required role

01 — FAIL: role=grid, no name
02 — PASS: role=grid, aria-label
03 — FAIL: role=radiogroup, no name (even though content has text)
Contact method
04 — PASS: role=radiogroup, aria-label
05 — FAIL: role=tree, no name (even though items have text)
Documents
06 — PASS: role=tree, aria-labelledby
File browser
Documents
07 — FAIL: role=meter, no name
08 — PASS: role=meter, aria-label
09 — FAIL: role=progressbar, no name
10 — PASS: role=progressbar, title

B. aria-labelledby referencing a hidden node still counts (spec-conformant)

11 — PASS: role=tree, aria-labelledby references aria-hidden node (still counts as name text per spec)
File browser

C. Empty/whitespace attribute edge cases

12 — FAIL: role=radiogroup, whitespace-only aria-label
13 — FAIL: role=grid, aria-labelledby references non-existent id
14 — FAIL: role=meter, empty title

D. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

15 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: role=grid, aria-hidden="true", not focusable, missing name
16 — EXCEPTION: role=grid, aria-hidden="true" but focusable (tabindex=0) => eligible, missing name => FAIL

E. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

17 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
18 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
19 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
20 — EXCEPTION: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible => eligible, missing name => FAIL

F. Inertness (ineligible)

21 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert on element itself
22 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor

G. Name allowed but NOT required by WAI-ARIA — out of this rule's scope

WAI-ARIA marks each of these "Accessible Name Required: False". Naming a tablist is a WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices recommendation, not a spec requirement, so an unnamed one is not an SC 4.1.2 failure and this rule reports nothing about it.

23 — NEUTRAL/OUT OF SCOPE: role=tablist, no name
24 — NEUTRAL/OUT OF SCOPE: role=toolbar, no name
25 — NEUTRAL/OUT OF SCOPE: role=menu, no name
26 — NEUTRAL/OUT OF SCOPE: role=menubar, no name
27 — NEUTRAL/OUT OF SCOPE: role=scrollbar, no name

End of fixture.
